philosophy.title: Our Philosophy | Web Design, Visual Identity & Digital Presence
philosophy.intro: We don't create isolated pieces; we build brands as cohesive systems.
philosophy.body1: At Vhetra, we bring together technology, design, and strategy to turn ideas into living identities. A brand is not defined by one element alone, but by the relationship between all of them: its digital architecture, visual identity, and online presence.
philosophy.body2: We create web design and digital presence for brands, projects, and businesses that want to communicate with clarity and consistency. We build fast, accessible websites that work beautifully on every device, combining Next.js, React, and modern technologies with thoughtful design direction.
philosophy.body3: We don't chase short-lived trends; we design structures with identity, made to work and made to last.
philosophy.body4: We are structure and sensitivity at once: code that breathes brand.

services.presenciaDigitalMini: A website paired with a visual identity
services.presenciaDigitalFull:
A website paired with a clear visual identity, so your brand can communicate professionally across the web and social media. Made for new businesses and projects that need a cohesive look across every digital channel.

Includes:

  • Landing page (A simple website to present your business and receive inquiries)
  • Adaptation of an existing logo
  • Typography selection (The fonts your brand will use)
  • Color palette (The colors that will visually represent your brand)
  • Basic visual kit (Graphic elements to keep your aesthetic consistent)
  • Identity adaptation for social media
  • 6 initial Instagram posts (Ready-to-publish designed pieces)


Available with monthly maintenance, which can include new posts each month.
services.marcaDigitalFull:
A complete visual system together with a website developed around your business's specific needs. Ideal for brands that need more than a basic informational site.

Includes:

  • Custom website development (May include appointments, service catalogs, bookings, or other features)
  • Branding (Logo design or redesign and brand visual style)
  • Typography and color definition
  • Social media adaptation
  • 6 initial posts
  • Graphic pieces for digital communication


Available as a monthly service that may include:

  • Website maintenance
  • Content updates
  • Post management
  • New monthly graphic pieces
services.presenciaEnRedesFull:
A visual and strategic foundation to help your brand start communicating professionally on social media. Ideal for businesses or projects that want to launch their Instagram presence with a clear identity, cohesive content, and an initial plan that makes it easier to stay active.

Includes:

  • 30 edited photos (Image optimization for social media, with attention to color, framing, and visual style)
  • 9 initial feed posts (Designed around the brand's visual identity to create an attractive, cohesive profile from the start)
  • One-month content calendar (Ideas and post topics planned to keep communication organized and consistent)
  • Existing logo adaptation (If needed, so it works properly on social media)
services.landingPageFull: A simple one-page website that presents your business, services or products, and contact options.
services.ecommerceMini: An online store to sell your products
services.ecommerceFull:
Development of an online store where customers can browse products, add them to their cart, and complete purchases.

Includes:

  • Product catalog
  • Shopping cart
  • Payment integration (for example, Mercado Pago)
  • Management panel for prices and stock
services.paginasPersonalizadasFull:
Website development with specific features for your activity or business model.

May include:

  • Appointment system
  • Calendars
  • Service catalog

services.manejoRedesFull:
Social media content management, including post design and visual brand adaptation.

Available as:

  • Initial identity package: Includes typography definition, colors, and design of 6 posts
  • Monthly service: Includes design of 6 posts per month. A previously defined visual identity is required.
services.brandingLogotipoFull:
Logo design and visual styling for your brand, helping keep a consistent presence across your website, social media, and printed materials.

Includes:

  • Logo design
  • Typography
  • Brand colors
  • Visual guidelines
services.mantenimientoWebFull: A monthly service that includes technical updates, content changes, and general website support. (Scope varies depending on website complexity)
services.hostingDominioMini: Services that keep your site online
services.hostingDominioFull:
The essential services your website needs to be available online.

  • Domains are registered through NIC Argentina, starting at approximately $8,000 per year
  • Hosting prices vary depending on the provider
  • Both are required for any website to work.
services.automatizacionesFull: Integration of forms, appointment systems, automated replies, or connections with external platforms. (Scope varies depending on the complexity of the requested feature)

acrodata.titulo: A digital experience designed to move with the body.
acrodata.descripcionP1: Includes a card gallery for exploring Acroyoga poses and a tool to combine them into custom flows. It also adds a classes section, an informational booklet, and simple direct contact, all within a lightweight interface.
acrodata.descripcionP2: Designed piece by piece, turning structure into aesthetics and functionality into flow.

estacionAlemania.titulo: A digital experience for discovering the history and flavors of Estacion Alemania.
estacionAlemania.descripcionP1: We developed an online menu that lets visitors easily explore the venue's food and drink offering. The site presents the full menu in Spanish and English, giving both tourists and local visitors clear, simple access to the same information.
estacionAlemania.descripcionP2: Beyond the digital menu, the website includes a brief history of the old railway station and an introduction to the Interpretation Center that operates in the same space, connecting the site's cultural value with its culinary experience. We also added direct access to Instagram, contact options, and location details to make visiting the station easier.

filiSuites.titulo: A visual identity designed to live in the digital space
filiSuites.descripcionP1: For Fili Suites, we worked on the visual identity for social media and the Instagram content strategy, creating a cohesive aesthetic inspired by the colors, textures, and atmosphere of the space.
filiSuites.descripcionP2: The communication is designed to reflect the calm and warmth of the accommodation, building a clear, professional online presence aligned with the guest experience.
